rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi or karmadhāraya compound qualifying the chanting; pañcākṣara refers to the five-syllable mantra and ādi indicates 'beginning with' or 'and so forth'
instrumental of action denoting the means of ritual performance
locative compound indicating two front areas or entrances; exact referent depends on ritual context
past participle in locative, describing the prepared surfaces
indeclinable indicating repetition or continuation of the ritual sequence
